Provide guidance for using the FRAX tool to determine if patient meets criteria for initiating treatment for low bone mass.

FRAX is an online validated risk calculator assessing osteoporosis fracture risk- need age, gender, weight, height, family and personal history of fractures, alcohol and smoking history, steroid use, and most recent DEXA scan lowest T-Score information placed into a calculator, and the results given are 10 year risk for any fracture vs 10 year hip fracture risk. If 10 year any fracture risk above 20% or hip fracture risk >3% there is an indication for starting treatment. Each group should access the online tool.
